title: Putnami Public JWKS
description: The PUBLIC JSON Web Key Set ({"keys":[...]}) a verifier fetches — the projection of a private keyring. It carries public verification material only: no private key material and no lifecycle state. Its shape matches go/framework/security.JWKS so a verifier can consume it directly. 'oct' symmetric keys never appear here.

keyType.description: Public JWK key type. Symmetric 'oct' keys have no public projection and never appear in a JWKS.

publicJwk.description: A public JSON Web Key. It has NO private-material fields (d, p, q, dp, dq, qi, k) by construction.
